message:
Now I can see the vulnerable code. Let me analyze the vulnerability:

1. `header_len = PACTYPE_LENGTH + (cbuffers * PAC_INFO_BUFFER_LENGTH);` - This can overflow if `cbuffers` is large enough.
2. `pac->pac = (PACTYPE *)realloc(pac->pac, sizeof(PACTYPE) + ((cbuffers - 1) * sizeof(PAC_INFO_BUFFER)));` - This can also overflow.
3. `if (buffer->Offset + buffer->cbBufferSize > len)` - This can overflow when checking buffer bounds.

Let me look at the constants and the PAC_INFO_BUFFER structure.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "PACTYPE_LENGTH\|PAC_INFO_BUFFER_LENGTH\|PAC_ALIGNMENT\|PAC_INFO_BUFFER" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/krb5/src/lib/krb5/krb/pac.c | head -20 && echo "---" && grep -n "typedef.*PAC_INFO_BUFFER\|struct.*PAC_INFO_BUFFER\|PACTYPE" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/krb5/src/include/k5-int.h /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/krb5/src/include/krb5/*.h 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
